reviews.title: Great midsize fire pit
reviews.body: Really like this fire pit, as most other reviewers have stated its mostly smokeless, in order for the "technology" to function, you really need a big enough fire such that all the walls are really hot; this generates the jets of hot air that come out the holes at the top and cause the 2ndary combustion. As a result, it will still smoke both at the beginning and the end when the fire is small and cooler. Also if you want a small fire, it will tend to stay cooler and thus smokier. That makes it really important that you pick the right size (19, 24 or 30) for the size fire you want to have most often.I really like the look, the contrast between the stainless still rim/legs and cor-ten body is really neat (assuming you like that look) Its a bit bulky and heavy, so I doubt I will be moving it around a lot or taking it with me on trips, the 19" and or solo stoves are clearly better adapted for that use, but it is small enough that you can move it from front to back yard with out to much hassle.It does really burn through wood rapidly, the higher temperature and airflow definitely causes it to consume more wood.So far pretty happy, only had it a week though, will update in a month or two.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 27, 2022

features: SMOKELESS FIRE PIT: Designed to create a warm, inviting atmosphere without the smoke, this fire pit is ideal for backyard gatherings or cozy evenings. Its stylish corten steel finish enhances any outdoor space while providing efficient heat. This smokeless fire pit will be the highlight of every gathering.

COMPATIBLE WITH BREEO ACCESSORIES - This outdoor fire pit is compatible with Breeo’s wide range of live-fire cooking accessories, offering endless outdoor cooking possibilities. From grilling to roasting, you can enhance your outdoor experience with added functionality using this outdoor firepit.

INNOVATIVE AIRFLOW TECHNOLOGY - Breeo’s patented X Airflow technology feeds oxygen to the fire, allowing it to ignite quickly and burn efficiently. This technology helps minimize smoke and provides a superior outdoor fire experience.

DOUBLE WALL CONSTRUCTION - The double-wall design and strategically placed secondary combustion holes of our portable fire pit ensure a truly smokeless burn. This advanced system provides cleaner air while allowing you to enjoy the warmth of a fire without the hassle of smoke.

MADE IN THE USA - Proudly made in the USA, our firepits for outside combines craftsmanship and quality. It’s built to last with heavy-duty steel, ensuring long-term durability in any outdoor environment.
